## Workload

Priya Anand completed the grading work during the review period. The workload comprised 753 reads, undertaken across 390 hours. This represents a rate of 1.9 reads per hour. The recorded workload provides the basis for considering the associated quality results and gives a clear account of the activity completed.

The volume and time recorded are presented together to support a consistent review of performance. No additional workload information is required for this assessment.

## Quality

A sample of 68 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The agreement result was 69.1 per cent. This result is recorded alongside the workload information to provide a balanced view of the grading activity and the outcome of the review.

No further action is required this quarter. The review was completed by Priya Anand, who was also the grader.
